newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Rogers, MCB push up Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Rogers, MCB push up Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: Gains in conglomerate Rogers and Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) pushed up the Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index Semdex on Friday, floor dealers said.
Semdex gained 3.79 points to 389.31 on transaction volume of 17.90 million rupees on 621,712 shares from 17.98 million rupees on 1,005,353 shares traded on Wednesday.
Rogers was six rupees higher to 113.00 rupees on 762 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd climbed 20 cents to 15.30 rupees on 2,700 shares. Shell was stable at 20 rupees on 15,255 shares.
The MCB rose 2.0 to 89 rupees on 79,607 shares and SBM was unchanged at 13 rupees on 209,400 shares.

In the hotel sector, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) gained 50 cents to 36 on 115,711 shares, Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) lost 20 cents to 45 rupees on 510 shares and Sun Resorts was stable at 49 rupees on 4,099 shares.
"There has been foreign investor buying interest in MCB, NMH and Sun Resorts," one broker said.
National carrier Air Mauritius rose 40 cents to 39.40 on 11,793 shares. Other leading shares were mostly stable.
